# Test Data Designer Skill

> **Category:** Generic Skills

## Overview

Use when designing test data sets covering positive, negative, edge, and boundary scenarios with data isolation.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [test-data-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
test-data-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@test-data-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Analyze complex systems and decompose into manageable components
- Design solutions following established patterns and conventions
- Generate structured artifacts with consistent formatting and quality
- Validate outputs against acceptance criteria and quality gates

## Industry Standards Applied

- **ISTQB Foundation**: Test design techniques, test levels, and test process framework
- **ISO 25010**: Software quality model: functional suitability, reliability, usability
- **OWASP Testing Guide**: Security testing methodology for web applications
